TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
NARRATIVE

The property is located at 1805-1809 W. Augusta Blvd, Chicago, IL 60647. The dot is 4,819
square feet. The property measures 48 feet along the W. Augusta Blvd. frontage. Currently, 1807
W. Augusta Blvd is vacant(unimproved and 1809 W. Augusta Blvd is improved with a 2-story
brick multi-unit residential building.

The property is owned by M15 Land Investments, LLC (the “Applicant”).

The Applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse
and Multi-Unit District to RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District to develop a Multi-Unit (3+
Units) Residential building comprised of six (6) Dwelling Units and six (6) off-street parking
spaces. The proposed building height is 38’-0” and the proposed building area is 8,192 SF.
Pursuant to Section 17-2-0207, Multi-Unit (3+ units) Residential is permitted by-right in the
RM-4.5 district.

(a) Floor Area Ratio. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0304-A, the maximum FAR in the RM-4.5
district is 1.70. The proposed project’s FAR is 1.70 (i.¢., 8,192 SF building area + 4,819 SF lot
area = 1.70). Therefore, the project conforms to the FAR standards.

(b) Density. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0301-A, the minimum /ot area in the RM-4.5 district
is 1,650 square feet. The subject property’s Jot area is 4,819 square feet. Therefore, the project
conforms to the minimum Jot area.

Section 17-2-0302 does not contain a minimum Jot frontage for lots in the RM-4.5 district.

Pursuant to Section 17-2-0303-A, the minimum /o¢ area per unit in the RM-4.5 district is 700
feet per Dwelling Unit. The proposed project will be comprised of six (6) Dwelling Units.
Therefore, the minimum /ot area per unit is 4,200 square feet. The subject property's Jot area is
4,819 square feet. Therefore, the project conforms to the minimum Jot area per unit standards.

(c) Off-street Parking. Pursuant to Section 17-10-0207-A, the minimum vehicle parking
requirement is | space per unit resulting in a minimum parking requirement of 6 off-street
vehicle parking spaces. The project proposes 6 off-street accessible spaces. Therefore, the project
conforms to the minimum vehicle parking requirements.

(d) Front Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0305-B, the required front setback is 15 feet or
12% of lot depth, whichever is less. In this case, the requirement is 3’-10” (i-e., 67-0” + 1-6" +
4°.0” / 3 =3’-10”). The proposed building front setback is 6’-8”. Therefore, the project does not
conform to the minimum front setback standard. However, in connection with the application for
azoning map amendment, the Applicant is seeking a variation from this setback requirement
pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B.

Rear Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0306-C, the minimum required rear setback is
30% of lot depth or 50 feet, whichever is less. Regarding this project, the required minimum is
30°-0” (i.e., 100.4’ x 30%). The proposed rear setback is 24’-10”. Therefore, the project does not
conform to the minimum reat setback standard. However, in connection with the application for
a zoning map amendment, the applicant is seeking a variation from this setback requirement
pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B.

Rear Open Yard. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0307, the minimum rear open yard space is
313 SF. The proposed project will provide 313 SF rear open yard space. Therefore, the project

conforms to this standard.

Side Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0309-A, the required side setback is 9’-7”
combined (i.¢., 48° x 20% = 9’-7”). The proposed east side setback is 3°-0” and the proposed
west side setback is 3’-0” for a total of 6’-0”. Therefore, the project does not conform to the

required rear setback standard. However, in connection with the application for a zoning map
amendment, the applicant is seeking a variation from this setback requirement pursuant to

Section 17-13-1101-B..

(e) Building Height. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0311-A, the maximum building height is 47”.
The proposed building height is 36”. Therefore, the project conforms to the building height
standards.
